title: Atmospheric oxidation of hydroxymethyl methyl α-lactone (HMML), initiated by OH radicals and Cl atoms
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,173-185
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00635J, Paper
Samsung Raja Daimari, Rabu Ranjan Changmai, Manabendra Sarma
Isoprene oxidizes in the presence of NO to form hydroxymethyl methyl α-alpha lactone (HMML), which further reacts with ˙OH and Cl to form product radicals that subsequently degrade to short-lived species.
